Good news, before opening
A punctual finish is easier with a plan

Travelers, please review your animal travel papers and carrier checks before you arrive at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Prepare early for a smooth handover. Our welfare coordinator checks comfort needs, while the safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention. Please keep pets calm, secure, and ready for inspection, and bring the documents listed by our team. <<FACT F027>> Follow staff direction without delay, and advise us at once if your pet has special handling needs.

We treat every journey as a shared responsibility. That means clear labels, clean carriers, and honest updates from travelers so the animal can be handled properly from check-in to departure. Ranger, if traveling with you, should be settled well before the desk opens to your side of the process. Sofia Chaudhary and Samuel Vega, along with all other travelers, should confirm that food, water, and comfort items are packed in the approved way.

If anything changes, speak with the desk immediately and keep your pet under control at all times. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help you complete each step in order. Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for final guidance before boarding.
